definitions.gloss: number of items; selection; variety of goods
definitions.explanation: The number or range of different items available, especially in a shop, restaurant menu, or product lineup.

examples.english: This shop has a large selection.

examples.japanese: ⟦ランチ→ランチ：11196_ranchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{品数|しなかず}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えて→増える：01183_fueru⟧⟦{嬉|うれ}しい→嬉しい：00822_ureshii⟧。
examples.english: I'm happy that the lunch menu has more items now.

examples.japanese: ⟦{閉店|へいてん}→閉店：09698_heiten⟧⟦{間際|まぎわ}→間際：14564_magiwa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{品数|しなかず}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}なく→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The selection gets smaller near closing time.

notes:
The number or variety of items available. Commonly used to evaluate shops, restaurant menus, and home-cooked meals.

FORMS:
⟦{品|しな}→品：03192_shina⟧ (item, goods) + ⟦{数|かず}→数：00204_kazu⟧ (number, count).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {品数|しなかず}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧: to have a large selection
- {品数|しなかず}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧: to have a limited selection
- {品数|しなかず}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{豊富|ほうふ}→豊富：03620_houfu⟧: to have a rich variety
- {品数|しなかず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{増|ふ}やす→増やす：02410_fuyasu⟧: to increase the number of items

USAGE:
In home cooking, {品数|しなかず}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{食卓|しょくたく}→食卓：03246_shokutaku⟧ refers to a dinner spread with many dishes — considered a sign of a well-prepared meal in Japanese culture.
